reuse.why: Changes only the off-day predicate inside the existing applyWeekendRule, reusing monthUtils.dayFromDate and the existing holiday Set.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is one extra lookup in the single predicate.

placement.why: The holiday matching lives in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend/holiday rule is already defined.

scope.why: A few lines in the predicate plus two focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and minimal; slicing the day string to get MM-DD is implicit and could use a short comment or named helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers go through applyWeekendRule, which is the only place changed.
